es.title: Mientras miras
es.question: ¿Qué cambia durante un clip completado?
es.takeaway: Durante clips completados la visión trabaja, mientras dos regiones de control reducen su actividad frente al reposo y a clips descartados.
es.alt: Esquema del cerebro durante videos completados: corteza visual activa, menor actividad en dACC y dlPFC y coordinación entre ambas regiones.
es.caption: Durante clips completados la visión trabaja, mientras dos regiones de control reducen su actividad frente al reposo y a clips descartados.

en.title: While you watch
en.question: What changes during a completed clip?
en.takeaway: During completed clips vision remains active while two control regions reduce activity relative to rest and to clips that were discarded.
en.alt: Brain diagram during completed videos showing active visual cortex, lower dACC and dlPFC activity, and coordination between both regions.
en.caption: During completed clips vision remains active while two control regions reduce activity relative to rest and to clips that were discarded.
